Native.description: The chain's native coin (BTC, ETH, SOL, ...).

FungibleToken.description: A fungible token issued by a contract or mint (ERC-20, SPL, ...).

NonFungibleToken.description: A non-fungible token (an attestation of value normally leaves these out).

WHAAccount.description: One wallet or account to read.

CHAIN_ID.description:
Chain, as a CAIP-2 chain identifier, e.g. "eip155:1",
"bip122:000000000019d6689c085ae165831e93",
"solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzQKqZKvdp".

CHAIN_NAME.description: Short chain label for display, e.g. "BTC", "ETH", "SOL".

ADDRESS.description: Address on that chain, as the chain writes it.

ACCOUNT_ID.description:
Identifier of the account record that links this wallet (an $ACT
ACCOUNT_ID), when there is one.

WHAHolding.description: One asset held at one address.

Native.description: The chain's native coin (BTC, ETH, SOL, ...).

FungibleToken.description: A fungible token issued by a contract or mint (ERC-20, SPL, ...).

NonFungibleToken.description: A non-fungible token (an attestation of value normally leaves these out).

SYMBOL.description:
Asset symbol as its issuer or quote source names it, e.g. "ETH",
"USDC"; a placeholder when it has none.

CONTRACT.description:
Contract address or mint of a token; empty for a native coin. This, not
SYMBOL, identifies the asset.

ASSET_ID.description:
CAIP-19 asset identifier, when known, e.g.
"eip155:1/erc20:0xa0b8...".

AMOUNT.description: Amount held, in whole units of the asset (base units / 10^DECIMALS).

AMOUNT_BASE_UNITS.description:
Amount held in base units, exact, as a decimal integer string; empty =
not reported.

DECIMALS.description:
Decimal places between base units and whole units; 0 = not stated or
none.

VALUED.description:
True when the holding was priced; VALUE and PRICE are meaningful only
then.

VALUE.description: Value of AMOUNT in the attestation's CURRENCY.

PRICE.description: Price of one whole unit in CURRENCY; 0 = not reported.

PRICE_SOURCE.description:
Where the price came from, e.g. "coinbase", "dexscreener", or the
balance service's own rate.

BALANCE_SOURCE.description: Where the balance came from, e.g. "mempool.space", a public RPC host.

WHAChain.description: One account's lookup on one chain.

TOKEN_COUNT.description: Assets with a positive amount at this address.

COMPLETE.description:
True when every balance at this address was read and every holding was
priced. When false, VALUE is a partial sum and the chain is named in
ERRORS.

VALUE.description:
Sum of the priced holdings' values in CURRENCY (complete only when
COMPLETE).

BLOCK_HEIGHT.description: Chain height the balances were read at; 0 = not reported.

COMMITMENT.description: Commitment level of the read, e.g. "finalized", "latest", "confirmed".

ERROR.description: Why the lookup is incomplete; empty when COMPLETE.

WHA.description:
Wallet Holdings Attestation - holdings of wallets across chains and their
value at one time.

ATTESTATION_ID.description: Identifier of this attestation; empty = not assigned.

SUBJECT_ID.description:
Whose holdings these are: a peer identifier, an account or an
organization; empty = the attester's own.

PURPOSE.description:
What the attestation is for, e.g. "security-bond", "treasury",
"collateral"; empty = general.

ACCOUNTS.description: Wallets read (in a request, the wallets to read).

ATTESTED.description:
True when at least one chain was read, every chain is COMPLETE and
ERRORS is empty: TOTAL_VALUE is then the attested value.

TOTAL_VALUE.description:
Sum of all priced holdings' values in CURRENCY. Meaningful as the
attested value only when ATTESTED; otherwise a partial sum.

ERRORS.description:
Problems met, one per line, e.g. "ETH: lookup incomplete"; empty when
ATTESTED.

AS_OF_MS.description:
Unix milliseconds the holdings were read (the as-of time); 0 in a
request.

ATTESTER_ID.description: Identifier of the attester (a peer identifier or module identifier).

SIGNATURE.description:
Attester's signature over the attestation, and its scheme (e.g.
"ed25519"); empty when unsigned.
